title: Lakeside Bar & Grill
venue_description:
North Peoria's Premier Entertainment Destination

Since 2008 Lakeside Bar and Grill has established itself as North Peoria's favorite sports bar and grill. The venue recently underwent comprehensive remodeling that created a modern inviting atmosphere while maintaining the warm neighborhood feel that keeps patrons coming back.

Live Music Performances

Lakeside hosts live music performances almost every Saturday night featuring local musicians and regional artists. The stage is equipped with professional sound and lighting systems to support quality performances. Musical styles range from rock and country to blues and acoustic sets. The Saturday night live music event has become a community tradition drawing music enthusiasts from across greater Peoria.

Food and Beverage Program

The menu features scratch-made American and Southwestern cuisine crafted from quality ingredients. Lakeside offers an impressive selection of craft beers with multiple rotating taps and bottled selections. The full liquor bar includes creative cocktails and signature drinks. The kitchen operates until late ensuring food availability for evening patrons. Famous Friday Fish Fry is a local tradition bringing crowds for fresh seafood offerings.

Entertainment and Events Calendar

Beyond Saturday live music the venue maintains an active entertainment calendar. Wednesday Trivia Night brings community members together for friendly competition. Tuesday Family Night features kids eat free pricing making it accessible for families. The establishment features wall-to-wall televisions for viewing all major sporting events including NFL college football baseball and hockey. Golden Tee and other interactive games provide additional entertainment options.

Atmosphere and Amenities

Multiple dog-friendly patios offer outdoor seating with misters to combat Arizona summer heat. The remodeled interior features comfortable seating and modern décor. The venue accommodates groups of various sizes and offers space for private events. Parking is convenient and readily available. Staff members are known for friendly and efficient service.

Community Connection

Lakeside Bar and Grill serves as a neighborhood anchor where locals gather to celebrate milestones enjoy entertainment and connect with friends. The venue's commitment to supporting local musicians and creating a welcoming atmosphere has made it an integral part of the North Peoria community fabric. Whether watching the big game enjoying live music or celebrating with friends Lakeside provides an experience that keeps the community engaged.

title: Peoria Center for the Performing Arts
venue_description:
A State-of-the-Art Cultural Venue

The Peoria Center for the Performing Arts (PCPA) stands as a crown jewel of Peoria's cultural infrastructure. This 13 million dollar facility completed in 2007 and designed by the architectural firm Westlake Reed Leskosky provides 20000 square feet of world-class performance and educational space.

Performance Facilities

The main stage auditorium seats 274 guests and features full theatrical capabilities including professional lighting and sound systems. The stage accommodates orchestras bands theatrical productions and large musical ensembles. A flexible 60-seat black box theater provides space for smaller productions experimental performances poetry readings and intimate concerts. Both theaters meet professional standards for artistic production.

Educational and Community Spaces

Two dedicated classrooms support arts education and workshops. An elegant lobby welcomes patrons and sets the tone for cultural experiences. Dressing rooms and backstage support areas provide full technical infrastructure. Office space houses Theater Works administration and supporting organizations.

Global Sounds Concert Series

The venue hosts the free Global Sounds concert series showcasing musicians and dancers from around the world. January through June performances feature diverse cultural traditions including West African music jazz and blues Latin American music Irish rock reggae and more. Each performance offers educational opportunities and cultural enrichment for all ages.

Theater Works Partnership

The City of Peoria partners with Theater Works a 501(c)3 nonprofit organization dedicated to creating engaging theatrical and educational experiences. Theater Works serves as the anchor tenant managing daily operations and curating programming. The nonprofit model ensures accessibility and community focus.

Programming Diversity

The venue hosts theatrical productions full-scale musicals concerts recitals educational performances and community events. Professional touring companies and local artists utilize the facilities. The diverse programming calendar ensures year-round cultural offerings for audiences of all ages and interests.

Community Impact

As Peoria's primary performing arts venue the PCPA serves as a cultural gathering place for the community. Free and low-cost programs ensure accessibility across socioeconomic lines. The facility provides professional platforms for emerging and established artists. Educational workshops and demonstrations support arts literacy and appreciation.

Technical Excellence

Professional-grade stage equipment lighting and sound systems support performances at the highest level. The acoustic design of both theaters ensures excellent sound quality. Video projection capabilities allow for multimedia presentations and educational content. The venue accommodates various event configurations from traditional theater seating to flexible arrangements.
